rank_rng_policy: Identical seed-7 adapter initialization; rank 0 keeps its post-initialization RNG stream, rank 1 starts its training RNG stream at seed 8; each rank restores its own saved stream.
batch_assignment: Alternate consecutive original two-comparison microbatches between ranks; no padding, dropping or duplication.
checkpoint_policy: Immutable completed-epoch files on each persistent local disk; common manifest only after both durable receipts agree; resume only from the latest manifest present identically on both ranks.
